description: Prompt-contrastive counterfactuals for the Sana hard render suite. These are used by scripts/self_oracle_sana_rank.py to score whether the FP16 teacher explains a candidate final latent better under the true prompt than under minimal missing-object or wrong-relation prompts.

items.prompt: A room with a yellow wall and visible text or glyphs on the wall.
items.positive: A room with a yellow wall and visible text or glyphs on the wall.
negatives: A room with a yellow wall and no text or glyphs on the wall.
A room with a blank yellow wall.
A room with abstract dark smudges on a yellow wall instead of readable text.

assertions.positive: A yellow wall with bold black text.
assertions.negative: A blank yellow wall with no text.

assertions.positive: A yellow wall with visible text or glyphs.
assertions.negative: A yellow wall with abstract dark smudges instead of text.

items.prompt: A wine bottle, a separate wine glass, and grapes arranged on a surface.
items.positive: A wine bottle, a separate wine glass, and grapes arranged on a surface.
negatives: A wine bottle and grapes arranged on a surface, without a wine glass.
Two wine bottles and grapes arranged on a surface.
A single wine bottle alone on a surface.
A wine bottle and grapes with the glass merged into the bottle.

assertions.positive: A wine bottle, a separate wine glass, and grapes.
assertions.negative: A wine bottle and grapes, with no wine glass.

assertions.positive: A wine bottle beside a separate wine glass.
assertions.negative: A wine bottle with no separate glass.

items.prompt: A harp with a solid frame and many individually visible strings.
items.positive: A harp with a solid frame and many individually visible strings.
negatives: A wooden sculpture shaped like a harp.
A soft translucent harp-shaped object with no solid frame.
A harp with generic vertical texture instead of individual strings.

assertions.positive: A harp with many clearly visible individual strings.

items.prompt: One person running beside or chasing one galloping horse.
items.positive: One person running beside or chasing one galloping horse.
negatives: A man riding a galloping horse.
Two galloping horses with no person.
A person running alone without a horse.
A person merged with a horse.

assertions.positive: A man running beside a galloping horse.
assertions.negative: A galloping horse with no person.

assertions.positive: A man running beside a galloping horse.
assertions.negative: A man riding a galloping horse.

assertions.positive: One horse and one running man.
